provider_execution_policy.installation_local_default: provider_route_config.json adjacent to the installation control DB; explicit FR_PROVIDER_ROUTE_CONFIG takes precedence
provider_execution_policy.unconfigured_provider_behavior: explicit_provider_unconfigured_gap; no delisting or population absence inference
provider_execution_policy.configured_provider_boundary: Credentials, entitlements, licensed feeds, user-owned files and custom API settings are installation-local and never bundled or committed.

population_semantics.explicit_selection: Caller supplies venue and code, optionally a listing start to disambiguate code reuse. FR resolves the authoritative episode.
population_semantics.current_population: Supported executable provider inventories are enumerated at acquisition time. The resulting package is source-discovered and records explicit identity, lifecycle, and availability gaps; it does not claim an absolute market denominator.
population_semantics.historical_interval_population: SSE and SZSE current and terminated Equity directories define supported historical Mainland episodes. BSE and HKEX executable providers provide current candidates plus explicit historical-population gaps. Current SSE/SZSE Fund directories identify surviving listings; terminated Fund population outside a supported directory remains an explicit unsupported population gap. Source-discovered rows are reconciled individually and unresolved rows remain explicit gaps.

venue_metric_boundaries.SSE_B_SZSE_B: Tencent amount remains source detail unless a venue/time native currency and scale contract is independently proved.
venue_metric_boundaries.HKEX: Sina unadjusted daily data is attempted only after executable provider candidates are cross-checked and an installation-local identity/lifecycle decision exists. Provider discovery does not supply currency or exact listing-start semantics; rows without a proved currency/time regime remain explicit coverage gaps and raw source detail.
